Specification: This file defines a trace-exploration wrapper around the EWD998 specification, together with auxiliary modules that expose a trace expression and a concrete two-state trace. The main module initializes the system state from the first element of a trace constant and advances by stepping between adjacent entries of that trace, while also defining a temporal property that negates eventual permanent convergence to a specific all-white, all-inactive, zero-counter, zero-pending state with a token at position 4. The file is not a full algorithm specification by itself; instead, it is a tooling-oriented monitor and replay setup built on top of the imported EWD998 module, with TLC configuration directives, a trace-expression module, and a module containing the concrete trace data.
